propositions: Batched overlap judge constructs RunRequest without operation-local output, structured-retry, transport-attempt, or timeout bounds, inheriting generic 16K-token / 600-second policy
Malformed candidate_id responses trigger three sequential structured generations and up to four transport retries before advisory abstention, consuming 216–311 seconds

Token-cap-only and schema-validation-only mutations prove insufficient; runtime defect requires combined lowering of output_token_limit, structured retries, transport attempts, and timeout_s in RunRequest

Repair applies operation-local budgets (1024 output tokens, 1 structured attempt, 1 transport attempt, 60-second timeout) to judge_batch calls via RunRequest seams lowered in _effective_config before model construction

Timeout, truncation, and malformed output must degrade to exact all-candidate abstention per story 9022 and ADR 0086; repair validated by deterministic FunctionModel tests and original-path replication
Existing callers omitting request-local limits retain prior defaults; lower-only config seams preserve backward compatibility
